_comment: v10 Phase A.1 source-cycle table. One row per cited standard listing the publishing body, the current edition, the cycle in years, the next-expected release date (best estimate), and a free-access URL. Used by scripts/check-citation-freshness.mjs to flag manifests whose 'edition' string is more than one cycle behind the current publication of that standard. spec-v22 CF-03: when 'next_expected' is in the past, the row must carry a 'last_verified' (ISO date >= next_expected) re-stamp -- the 'verified, not yet released' acknowledgement -- or the freshness gate fails. Update on each rollover (see docs/citation-freshness-ledger.md). Since 2026-09-02 the file also carries `annual_figures`: the bundled federal dollar figures that reprice every year on a known calendar (IRS mileage, Section 179, the SSA wage base, FHFA and HUD loan limits, GSA per-diem, HUD FMRs, Pub 15-T). Five of them were found stale on one day; nothing had ever asked when their publisher last spoke.

standards.name: NEC (NFPA 70)
standards.verification_note: NEC 2026 (NFPA 70-2026) published on the standard NFPA three-year cycle. Bundled ampacity/correction values still follow NEC 2023 (disclosed-lag per NEC_DISCLOSURE); the 2026 value refresh is a data change tracked separately.

standards.name: International Plumbing Code
standards.verification_note: 2027 I-Code final vote completed August 2026; the editions publish in stages. Publication schedule re-confirmed 2026-09-02 against ICC's announced dates: IBC, IFC and IWUIC anticipated September 2026; IECC 2026-12-31; IRC February 2027. The IPC / IMC / IFGC dates in this file remain estimates. last_verified stays 2026-09-01, the last date non-publication was actually confirmed -- the 2026-09-02 pass reached only the anticipated schedule (shop.iccsafe.org 404s and codes.iccsafe.org 403s an automated fetch), and an anticipated date is not a verification. IBC and IFC are due within the month: when next_expected passes, confirm at shop.iccsafe.org and either advance the row to 2027 or re-stamp last_verified on or after next_expected.

standards.name: ASHRAE Standard 62.1
standards.verification_note: Verified 2026-09-01: ANSI/ASHRAE 62.1-2025 IS PUBLISHED and supersedes 62.1-2022 (ANSI/ASHRAE store listings, ASHRAE announcements). Bundled ventilation-rate values still follow 62.1-2022, which is a value refresh tracked separately; the citation must name 2025 as the current edition. Release month recorded as the 2025 publication window, not a day-precise stamp.

standards.name: ASHRAE Standard 62.2
standards.verification_note: Verified 2026-09-01: ANSI/ASHRAE 62.2-2025 IS PUBLISHED (16 addenda to the 2022 edition, including MERV 6 -> MERV 11 filtration). Bundled values still follow 62.2-2022; the value refresh is tracked separately.

standards.name: ASHRAE Standard 90.1
standards.verification_note: Verified 2026-09-01: ANSI/ASHRAE 90.1-2025 IS PUBLISHED (105 addenda to the 2022 edition). Bundled values still follow 90.1-2022; the value refresh is tracked separately.

standards.name: FDA Food Code
standards.verification_note: Verified 2026-09-02 against fda.gov: the 2022 Food Code (10th edition) is still the most recent published edition, and FDA has said a 2026 edition is coming later this year on the four-year interval it moved to after 2017. This row had carried no last_verified at all, so the gate could only ever have failed on it, never been satisfied. Recheck at fda.gov/food/retail-food-protection/fda-food-code when next_expected passes.

standards.name: AASHTO Green Book (Policy on Geometric Design)
standards.verification_note: Verified 2026-09-01: the 8th edition is NOT yet published. NCHRP 07-29, the research project developing it, was scheduled to complete 2026-03-31, so publication follows that rather than precedes it. The 2018 7th edition remains current; bundled geometric-design defaults follow it and the citation discloses it.

annual_figures.name: IRS standard mileage rate
annual_figures.verification_note: 2026 is a split year: 72.5 c/mi from Jan 1 (Notice 2026-10), 76 c/mi from Jul 1 (IR-2026-29). The IRS may revise mid-year, so a December-only recheck is not enough.

annual_figures.name: IRC 179 cap / phase-out and IRC 168(k) bonus
annual_figures.verification_note: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act rewrote both from 2025: cap $2,500,000 / phase-out $4,000,000 (2026: $2,560,000 / $4,090,000), bonus a permanent 100% for property acquired after 2025-01-19. The bundled table was still the repealed TCJA phase-down until 2026-09-02. Watch for statute changes, not only the annual Rev. Proc.

annual_figures.name: Social Security contribution and benefit base
annual_figures.verification_note: Announced with the annual COLA. 2026 is $184,500; the bundled value was $183,600 until 2026-09-02. ssa.gov 403s an automated fetch -- irs.gov/taxtopics/tc751 carries the same figure.

annual_figures.name: FHFA conforming loan limit values
annual_figures.verification_note: 2026 baseline $832,750 / $1,066,250 / $1,288,800 / $1,601,750; ceiling $1,249,125. The shard was stamped year 2026 with verified_on 2026-05-16 and carried the 2025 cycle throughout.

annual_figures.name: HUD FHA single-family mortgage limits
annual_figures.verification_note: Floor is 65% and ceiling 150% of the FHFA conforming baseline; 2026 is $541,287 / $1,249,125 per ML 2025-23. Verify alongside the FHFA row, never separately.

annual_figures.name: GSA CONUS per-diem rates
annual_figures.verification_note: FY2026 standard CONUS $110 lodging / $68 M&IE; M&IE tiers $68 / $74 / $80 / $86 / $92. The bundled M&IE figures were the FY2023 tiers until 2026-09-02. The tier a state sits in is this project's approximation; a tier's value is GSA's.

annual_figures.name: HUD Fair Market Rents
annual_figures.verification_note: NOT re-verified on 2026-09-02: the per-area figures sit behind the huduser.gov lookup and could not be confirmed from the published summaries. One row is doubted -- the shard names 'San Francisco-Oakland-Berkeley, CA HUD Metro FMR Area', which is the OMB CBSA name, while HUD splits that CBSA into the San Francisco and Oakland-Fremont HMFAs with different FMRs. Confirm against the FY2026 FMR schedule before trusting the 19-area snapshot.

annual_figures.name: IRS Publication 15-T percentage-method brackets
annual_figures.verification_note: The shard declares edition 2025 and the tile discloses the year and that the brackets are single-filer and illustrative. Left as-is on 2026-09-02: it is disclosed rather than stale-and-silent, and this row exists so the next reader is asked.

annual_figures.name: IRS Pub 946 Table A-1 MACRS percentages
annual_figures.covers: tax year; Pub 946 is revised annually
annual_figures.verification_note: Verified 2026-09-03 against Publication 946 (2025), page 70, Table A-1 (half-year convention), fetched as irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p946.pdf. All six recovery periods match value for value, including the 15-year 5.90/5.91 and 20-year 4.462/4.461 alternations and the 21st-year 2.231 stub. The percentages are statutory and have not moved since 1986, so the annual ask is whether the bundled TABLE is still the published table, not whether a rate repriced.

annual_figures.name: IRS Form 1040-ES estimated-tax due dates
annual_figures.covers: calendar tax year; four dates, the fourth falling in January of the next year
annual_figures.verification_note: Verified 2026-09-03 against the 2026 Form 1040-ES, fetched as irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1040es.pdf: 1st April 15 2026, 2nd June 15 2026, 3rd Sept 15 2026, 4th Jan 15 2027. Matches the bundled 2026 row exactly. Weekend and federal-holiday rollover is already applied in the published schedule, so the shard must carry the IRS dates rather than compute them.
